ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_rank_gap_tanh_advantage_repaired_sum
ir.intuition: This loss retains the pairwise log-probability difference and tanh-scaled delta_rank scoring but changes the aggregation from mean to sum. Summation emphasizes the total accumulated loss over the batch instead of the average, allowing more flexible weighting and interpretation in certain training regimes.
ir.pseudocode:
delta = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
rank_scale = tanh(alpha * delta_rank)
sigmoid_delta = sigmoid(delta)
loss = relu(1 - rank_scale * sigmoid_delta) * weight
final_loss = sum(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    delta = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    rank_scale = ops.tanh(ops.mul(alpha, delta_rank))
    sigmoid_delta = ops.sigmoid(delta)
    loss = ops.relu(ops.sub(1, ops.mul(rank_scale, sigmoid_delta)))
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.sum(loss)
